crop.notes: Whole 'Paddy Ryan's Guff' letter from headline to the MACON signature; Allen is mentioned once in the first paragraph

ocr.notes: Mostly right; scattered garbles (e.g. 'GUFE', 'George ites mig' for George Freyer, 'Polo Gioonta', several phrases in the Ashton and Fogarty paragraphs)

title.suggested: Philadelphia Letter Says Goss's Backers Robbed Allen at Walton

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch printed a Philadelphia sporting letter on Paddy Ryan, which said Joe Goss had been dubbed Champion of America because his backers robbed Tom Allen out of their fight at Walton, Kentucky.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Saturday, May 29, 1886, page 9; letter datelined Philadelphia, May 27, signed MACON

facts.fact: A Philadelphia correspondent wrote that Joe Goss was dubbed Champion of America because the gang behind him robbed Allen out of their fight at Walton, Kentucky

notes: Allen appears in one sentence of a long column about Paddy Ryan, Arthur Chambers, McCaffrey and others, so focus is passing. The claim is the correspondent's opinion; the fight date (1876) comes from the known Goss fight, not this article, which gives none.
